QLINE.name: Q-Line Biotech Ltd
QLINE.one_line: Q-Line Biotech's move into reagent manufacturing is real and its FY26 margin gains are audited, but about two-thirds of revenue goes to a promoter partnership, three years of profit have not turned into cash, and at Rs 726 the share trades above even our model bull value of Rs 382.9 while implying about 45% annual sales growth for five years.
